protocol.target: Subsequent documented named bacterial pathogen in blood collected before 72 postnatal hours; unadjudicated research phenotype
protocol.eligibility: First admission before 72h, explicit bacterial no-growth or named-pathogen early culture, prediction strictly before first early blood culture, >=2 distinct vitals recorded and available in prior 6h.
protocol.availability: max(CHARTTIME, STORETIME) <= landmark; missing STORETIME excluded
protocol.unit_context: ITEMID 1004 is Respiratory Rate in D_ITEMS. Its csv bpm is interpreted as breaths/minute by this item identity, not as heart rate. Pulse (1002) remains a distinct measurement from Heart Rate (1003). Measured weight is not relabelled birth weight.
protocol.outcome_policy: Named pathogen overrides other reports. Otherwise every report must explicitly exclude bacteria. Unresolved Gram reports, possible contaminants, fungi, missing and fungus-only negatives are excluded.
explicit_bacterial_negatives: cultured for 5 days without bacteria, fungus growth
protocol.laboratory_policy: Excluded: no result-availability timestamp in LABEVENTS. CHARTTIME alone cannot establish prospective availability.
protocol.split_policy: Patient-disjoint; shifted calendar dates are not a real chronological validation split.

limitations: No clinical phenotype/contaminant adjudication; controls are culture-negative, not proven free of sepsis.
Conditioning on culture testing and survival to landmarks causes selection bias; hospital-only cohort.
Midnight birth times may be date-only; sensitivity analysis excludes them.
Gestation, birthweight and linked maternal fields are not supplied as structured predictors in these selected tables.
Repeated landmarks increase rows, not the number of independent positive infants.
No result time for microbiology; only collection-time phenotype is used, never outcome availability as a predictor.
